briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate multi-agent capabilities as compute race intensifies.

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier has accelerated with multiple model releases this month. Geopolitical tensions around compute access are rising. Funding remains robust across frontier labs and infrastructure providers.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic launched Claude 4.5 featuring improved reasoning chains. Google DeepMind and Meta both deployed new internal models while DeepSeek v3.5 gained traction in open-source benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with applications expanding to automotive and IoT sectors.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced next-gen Blackwell refresh shipments. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 100k H100 equivalent clusters in the US and EU.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US labs more than Chinese competitors by Q4 2026?
